parts.text: State what is meant by the photoelectric effect.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
The photoelectric effect is investigated using two clean metal plates. One plate is made from metal X and the other is made from metal Y.

Metal X has work function energy $\Phi$. Metal Y has work function energy $2\Phi$. Metal X has threshold frequency $F$.

State expressions, in terms of either or both of $\Phi$ and $F$, for
parts.text: the threshold frequency of metal Y
